Real work, live and verifiable

WordPress SEO · Own Project

Blessing Paths — full WordPress SEO overhaul

My own live WordPress blog, “Find Hope & Share Blessings.” I ran the complete program myself: audit, fixes, security, speed and content structure.

blessingpaths.com ↗
19Published posts
8Content categories
79/100Full website audit score
1 yrBrowser cache TTL set
  • RankMath homepage SEO — title “Daily Blessings, Prayers & Good Morning Wishes | Blessing Paths” with a full meta description
  • Sitemap restored — sitemap_index.xml was returning 404; fixed via permalink flush and LiteSpeed cache purge
  • Homepage H1 fixed — verified as exactly one H1 on the homepage and on post pages
  • Navigation built from scratch — Main Menu with a single “Blessings” dropdown holding all categories, moved to first position
  • Security hardening — Limit Login Attempts Reloaded, Disable XML-RPC-API and Really Simple Security installed
  • LiteSpeed speed optimization — CSS/JS minify, JS deferred, HTML minify, lazy-load images and 1-year browser cache, layout verified intact
